verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents on-device language, speech and vision models: LLM generation, a VLM API that takes an image and a prompt, and image generation. That covers LLMs and some multi-modal use, but nothing shows breadth across hundreds of architectures. missing for 10: evidence of support for hundreds of model architectures, any MoE model support, embedding model support, a list of supported architectures, independent corroboration of model breadth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: The RunAnywhere Kotlin SDK runs language, speech, and vision models on the device.
`RunAnywhere.vlm` takes an image and a prompt.
`RunAnywhere.images` generates an image from a prompt.
